sentences.text: The order dated 28.11.2024 regarding stay realization of fine amount is made until further orders.
I.A. No.2848 of 2024 is disposed of.

2. List this appeal in the 1st week of December 2025 for hearing.
3.
Heard Mr. D. Panda, learned counsel for Appellant and Mr. S.K. Rout, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for State- Respondent.

4. The Appellant, namely, Rakesh Dehury@Pinu, who has been convicted by learned Ad-hoc Addl.
Sessions Judge, Fast Track Special Court, Dhenkanal in the judgment dated 08.10.2024 in C.T.
(Sessions) Case No.187/2023/18/2023 for commission of offence under Sections 376(2)(f)/376(2)(n), I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 10 years along with fine, has prayed to release him on bail pending appeal.
Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Date: 10-Jul-2025 17:55:26 5.

entities.text:
Addl.
Sessions Judge, Fast Track Special Court, Dhenkanal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that the Appellant is inside custody since 9.10.2024 till date.
It is further submitted that the Appellant is the cousin brother of the victim and according to the statement of the victim there was consensual relationship with promise to marry.

6. Upon hearing both parties and taking note of the evidences of the witnesses including the victim (P.W.9) and the circumstances of the case, it is directed to release the present Appellant on bail pending appeal in connection with the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as the learned Ad-hoc Addl. Sessions Judge, Fast Track Special Court, Dhenkanal may deem just and proper.
